paite: Balaam in Balak kiang ah, "Hiai ah maitam sagih hon bawlsak inla, bawngtal sagih leh belampa sagih hon suktuahsak in," achi hi.
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bulls and seven rams.”

paite: Balak in Balaam gen bang in ahih a; Balak leh Balaam in maitam chin ah bawngtal khat leh belam khat alan uhi.
english: Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bull and a ram.

paite: Balaam in Balak kiang ah, "Na halmang thillat bul ah ana dingh gige inla, kei ka va paituam ding. Kei hon houpih ding in TOUPA ahong pai kha thei hi. Ama'n hon hilh peuhmah ka hon hilh ding," achi hi.
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go: perhaps Yahweh will come to meet me; and whatever he shows me I will tell you.” He went to a bare height.

paite: Huchi in mual giau velvul ah ahohtou hi. Pathian in Balaam ana kituahpih hi. Balaam in akiang ah, "Maitam sagih ka bawl khin a; maitam chih ah bawngtal khat leh belampa khat ka lan chiat," achi hi.
english: God met Balaam: and he said to him, “I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.”

paite: TOUPA'N Balaam kam ah thu akoih a, "Balak kiang ah kik nawn inla, va gensawn in," achi hi.
english: Yahweh put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak.”

paite: Huchi in akiang ah akik nawnta a; ngai in, ahalmang thillat bul ah amah leh Moab milian tengteng leng ana dingh lai uhi.
english: He returned to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.

paite: Ama'n thu agenta a, "Aram a pan Balak in ahon pi a, suahlam tang a Moab kumpipa'n, 'Hong inla, Jakobte hon hamsiatsak in, hong inla, Israelte hong dalsak in!' achi a.
english: He took up his parable, and said, “From Aram has Balak brought me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East. Come, curse Jacob for me. Come, defy Israel.

paite: Bangchi in Pathian hamsiat louh ka hamsiat dia? Bangchi in Pathian dal louh ka dal dia?
english: How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? How shall I defy whom Yahweh has not defied?

paite: Amau lah suangpi tung a pan ka mu ngal a, mualte a pan amau ka mu a, ngai in, mite atuam in ateng ding ua, namte lak a simtel louh ding ahi uh.
english: For from the top of the rocks I see him. From the hills I see him. Behold, it is a people that dwells alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.

paite: Jakobte leivui kua'n asim thei dia, Israelte mun li a khen, mun khat kua'n ahia sim thei ding? Midiktat sih in si sam ning, ka tawpna amah a bang hi hen!" achi hi.
english: Who can count the dust of Jacob, or number the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous! Let my last end be like his!”

paite: Balaam kiang ah Balak in, "N'on bawldan bangchidan ahia? Ka melmate hamsiat ding in ka hon pi a, na vualzawl zaw mawk ngal a!" achi hi.
english: Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have blessed them altogether.”

paite: Ama'n adawng a, "TOUPA'N ka kam a akoih ka gen ding mah hilou ding maw?" achi hi.
english: He answered and said, “Must I not take heed to speak that which Yahweh puts in my mouth?”

paite: Balak in akiang ah, "Mun dang ah hoh nawn dih ni e, huai a pan na thei vek ding. A-omna chiang uh na mu ding, avek un zaw na mu vek khol kei ding. Huai a pan hon hamsiatsak in," achi hi.
heading: Balaam Thugen Nihna
english: Balak said to him, “Please come with me to another place, where you may see them; you shall see but the utmost part of them, and shall not see them all: and curse me them from there.”

paite: Huchi in Zophimte tenna Pisgah vum ah apitou a, maitam sagih adoh a, maitam chih ah bawngtal khat leh belampa khat alan hi.
english: He took him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.

paite: Balak kiang ah, "Pam a TOUPA ka va houpih sung in na halmang thillat bul ah ana dingh lai in," achi hi.
english: He said to Balak, “Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet over there.”

paite: TOUPA'N Balaam ana kituahpih a, akam ah thu akoih a, "Balak kiang ah kik nawnta inla, akiang ah va gensawn in," achi hi.
english: Yahweh met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and say this.”

paite: Akiang ah ava hoh a, ngai in, ahalmang thillat bul ah ana dingh nilouh hi. Moab miliante leng akiang ah a-om uh. Balak in akiang ah, "TOUPA'N bang ana gen a?" achi hi.
english: He came to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. Balak said to him, “What has Yahweh spoken?”

paite: Ama'n thu agenta hi: "Thou inla, Balak, ngaikhia in. Zippor tapa, ka thu ngai in.
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Rise up, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, you son of Zippor.

paite: Pathian zaw Zuauhat mihing ahi kei. Kisik hat mihing tapa leng ahi sam kei. Agensa ahih kei dia hia? Ana gensa ahih piching kei dia hia?
english: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor the son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and will he not do it? Or has he spoken, and will he not make it good?

paite: Ngai in, vualzawl ding in thupiak ka mu a, ama'n avualzawl khin a, ke'n ka hihlamdang thei kei.
english: Behold, I have received a command to bless. He has blessed, and I can’t reverse it.

paite: Jakobte ah thulimlouhna amu kei a, Israelte ah phengphitna amu sam kei. TOUPA a Pathian uh akiang uah a-om a, alak uah kumpipa kikou husa a-om hi.
english: He has not seen iniquity in Jacob. Neither has he seen perverseness in Israel. Yahweh his God is with him. The shout of a king is among them.

paite: Aigupta a pan Pathian in apikhia a, gam bawngtal tha bang anei uhi.
english: God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox.

paite: Jakobte tung ah bumhaina a-om kei a; Israelte tung ah leng khimhaina a-om sam kei hi. Jakobte leh Israelte kiang ah Pathian thilhih hihlat ahi!
english: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; Neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What has God done!

paite: Ngai in, humpinelkai lian bang in mipite athou ua, humpinelkai dawng bang in adingtou ua; asamat uh anek ma un akual kei ding uh, amat uh sisan adawn ma un," achi hi.
english: Behold, the people rises up as a lioness, As a lion he lifts himself up. He shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, and drinks the blood of the slain.”

paite: Balak in Balaam kiang ah, "Hamsiat ke'nla, vualzawl leng vualzawl het ke'n," achi hi.
english: Balak said to Balaam, “Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.”

paite: Himahleh Balaam in adawng a, Balak kiang ah, "TOUPA'N agen tengteng ka hih ngeingei ding ahi chi in ka hon hilh khin ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
english: But Balaam answered Balak, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘All that Yahweh speaks, that I must do?’”

paite: Balak in Balaam kiang ah, "Hong dih, mun dang ah ka hon pi nawn dia, huai a pan na hon hamsiatsak Pathian in phal kha zenzen hiam," achi hi.
heading: Balaam Thugen Thumna
english: Balak said to Balaam, “Come now, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will please God that you may curse me them from there.”

paite: Huchi in Jeshimon lam nga Peor vum ah Balak in Balaam apitouta hi.
english: Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks down on the desert.

paite: Balaam in Balak kiang ah, "Hiai ah maitam sagih hon bawlsak inla, bawngtal sagih leh belampa sagih hon suktuahsak in," achi hi.
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bulls and seven rams.”

paite: Balak in Balaam gen bang in ahih a, maitam chih ah bawngtal khat leh belampa khat alan hi.
english: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.
